objects.name: nanovdbRectilinear
objects.description: NanoVDB grid mapped through per-axis (non-uniform) coordinates

parameters.name: coordsX
parameters.description: object-space coordinates along the X axis

parameters.name: coordsY
parameters.description: object-space coordinates along the Y axis

parameters.name: coordsZ
parameters.description: object-space coordinates along the Z axis

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: filter mode used to interpolate the grid

parameters.name: dataCentering
parameters.description: whether data values sit on grid vertices (node) or at cell centers (cell)

parameters.name: roi
parameters.description: object-space box the field is clipped to (default: unbounded)
